That is the only real demand signal: buyers still outnumber sellers in the most recent window, and the price is holding near its high.

The case against is stronger. Ten buyers from 601 SOL in the first two minutes, with a top-5 buyer share of 99.96% and a bundle share of 1.0, points to coordinated operator accumulation rather than organic interest. The last 15 minutes show 9.71 SOL bought against 8.49 SOL sold, a near-even split, so the flow is not building. The graduation-adjacent curve data shows full bundling. Operator-class coins have been roughly break-even as a group, and after 1.4-5.1% round-trip costs, break-even is a loss.

Verdict: no strong case. I would skip, and I would not treat the recent buyer count as evidence of durable demand, since it sits on top of a bundled launch.
